command.name: Eventide Strike
verbatim: Each Round: 20% chance to afflict Slow on 1 Enemy in the same lane for 2 round(s).
Rounds 1, 3, 6, 8: Deal Tactical Damage to 1 Enemy in the same lane (Damage Rate: +70%).

vanguard.name: Sentinel's Wit
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard, increase Tactical Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Instinct and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

habits.name: Strategic Leader
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase Tactical Damage Dealt by +8% of 1 Ally in any lane (prioritizes the Vanguard) until the end of combat.

habits.name: Dragon's Insight
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce your Damage Received by -4% and increase your Instinct by +5% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Savior's Waltz
habits.verbatim: Each Round: 13% chance to apply Resistance (-10%) to yourself and 1 other Ally within adjacency for 2 round(s).

habits.name: Insightful Allies
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase Instinct by +8% (enhanced by Instinct) of 3 Allies in any lane until the end of combat.

habits.name: Midnight Onslaught
habits.verbatim: Rounds 6-10: 24% chance to afflict Confusion on 1 Enemy within adjacency for 2 round(s).
